title: Together or Baseten raises at a $5B-plus valuation by Q4 2027
body: Fireworks AI closed a $1.505 billion Series D at a $17.5 billion valuation this week, disclosing that annualized revenue run-rate has crossed $1 billion — up roughly fivefold from its prior round — while the platform now serves more than 40 trillion tokens a day, over 95% of them from models specialized on customers' own proprietary data rather than general-purpose frontier endpoints. NVIDIA joined the round alongside Atreides Management, Index Ventures and TCV, a signal that the chipmaker treats the managed serving-and-fine-tuning layer as strategically valuable in its own right rather than merely a downstream consumer of GPUs. Fireworks frames itself inside a peer set — Together AI, Baseten and other hosted-inference specialists — that it says now commands frontier-scale economics, the same tier once dismissed as thin-margin API resale. The prediction is that this re-rating does not stay confined to one company: at least one of those named managed-inference peers, Together AI or Baseten, announces a new primary funding round at a valuation of $5 billion or more by Q4 2027, as investors extend the specialized-serving thesis — enterprises owning fine-tuned models on a managed high-performance stack instead of renting general endpoints — across the whole category. A single outsized round can be read as a company-specific outcome; a second peer clearing multi-billion-dollar, frontier-scale terms is what converts specialized inference from a feature of the model-hosting market into an independently fundable venture tier.

reasoning.because: Fireworks closed a $1.505B Series D at $17.5B on $1B-plus ARR, ~5x growth, NVIDIA participating
reasoning.given: Fireworks frames Together and Baseten as peers in a serving tier now at frontier-scale economics
reasoning.so_that: At least one named peer, Together AI or Baseten, raises a new round at a $5B-plus valuation
reasoning.landing: by Q4 2027; ≥1 Together or Baseten round announced at $5B+ valuation
reasoning.plain_language: Fireworks' huge raise proved renting out fine-tuned AI models is big business, so soon rival Together or Baseten raises money at a similar scale.

summary: Fireworks AI's $1.505B Series D valued it at $17.5B on $1B-plus ARR, re-rating the managed-inference serving tier and drawing in NVIDIA. It frames Together AI and Baseten as peers now at frontier-scale economics, so at least one is predicted to raise at a $5B-plus valuation by Q4 2027.
